About Us

GoMandi Quick Commerce


GoMandi is a quick-delivery grocery and daily-needs app. We deliver fresh produce, daily essentials, and groceries in Kolkata, West Bengal, typically within 10-15 minutes. GoMandi ('we') is operated by GoMandi Team, Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

Terms & Conditions

Terms of Service


1. GoMandi ("we") is operated by GoMandi Team, Kolkata, West Bengal, India. By using the app or website you agree to these terms.
2. You must be 18+ or use the app under a parent's/guardian's supervision, and provide correct name, phone and address.
3. Products are subject to availability. Prices (in ₹, inclusive of applicable taxes) and offers may change without notice; the price at the time of ordering applies.
4. Delivery is available only in serviceable areas in Kolkata, West Bengal. Delivery times (e.g. 10–15 minutes) are estimates and can vary with traffic, weather and demand.
5. Payment: Cash on Delivery or online payment through our payment partners. We do not store your card/UPI details.
6. Orders can be cancelled/replaced as per our Refund, Cancellation & Replacement Policy.
7. Do not misuse the app (fake orders, abuse of delivery partners, fraud). We may suspend such accounts.
8. Liability is limited to the value of the order, to the extent permitted by law. Nothing here removes your rights under Indian consumer law.
9. These terms are governed by Indian law; disputes are subject to courts in Kolkata, West Bengal.
10. Contact: gomandi907@gmail.com, support@gomandi.store, +91 8282832737. Grievance Officer: GoMandi Support (gomandi907@gmail.com).

Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy


1. We collect: name, email and profile photo (Google login), phone number, delivery addresses and location (when you allow it), order history, photos/videos you attach to complaints, and basic device/app information.
2. We use it to take and deliver orders, process payments, give support, improve the app and send order updates.
3. We share data only as needed: with delivery partners (name, phone, address), payment providers, and cloud/hosting providers (e.g. Google Firebase). We do not sell your data.
4. Location is used only for delivery and you can turn it off in your phone settings.
5. Data is stored securely, and kept as long as your account is active or the law requires.
6. You can view or correct your saved details in the app, or ask us to delete your account and data at gomandi907@gmail.com.
7. The app is not meant for children under 13 to use on their own.
8. We may update this policy; the date of the latest update is shown here: October 21, 2026.
9. Contact: gomandi907@gmail.com, +91 8282832737.

Refund, Cancellation & Replacement Policy

Refund, Cancellation & Replacement Policy


Cancellation: You can cancel before the order is packed or out for delivery from "All Orders". After that, cancellation may not be possible.

Replacement/Refund: If an item is damaged, wrong, missing or expired, raise a complaint within 72 hours of delivery from Profile → Raise Complaint / Issue with photos. We will replace the item or refund it after verification.

Eligible Items: Damaged, incorrect, missing, or expired packaged groceries. (Note: Fresh vegetables/fruits/dairy must be inspected upon delivery).

Refund: Online payments are refunded to the original payment method within 5–7 working days depending on your bank/payment provider. COD refunds will be issued via bank transfer or wallet/store credit.

Failed Payments: If money is deducted but no order is created, it will be refunded automatically by Cashfree/bank or after manual verification.
